document.title: fix(scripts): agent-check runs on the pinned Node and builds JS before tsc
document.summary: `scripts/agent-check.sh` reruns itself on the `.nvmrc` Node, installs, and builds JS before `tsc`; `pnpm install` fails on an old Node; docs say `docker compose`.
document.why: Fresh worktrees started on Node 22 with no built SDK and failed `tsc` until someone fixed them by hand, and docs called a `docker-compose` binary that is not installed [retro item 4](source:s1).

sources.label: Claude session · Oct 27
sources.gist: Retro on the unattended threads behind PRs #127–#135 lists six vitadeck guardrail fixes.

sources.label: PR #137
sources.gist: Node pin, JS build before tsc, docker compose docs.

lookFor: `.nvmrc` and `engines.node` already existed before this PR; the fix makes the check script and `pnpm install` enforce them rather than adding a new pin.

groups.title: Run on the pinned Node
groups.why: The shell's default Node on this Mac is 22, and nothing stopped a check from running on it [retro item 4](source:s1).
groups.summary: `use_pinned_node` compares the running Node major with `.nvmrc` before `fast`, `host` and `full`, and `engineStrict` makes `pnpm install` enforce `engines.node`.
lookFor: Subtle: with fnm on `PATH`, a Node 22 shell does not fail; the script `exec`s `fnm exec --using=.nvmrc` on itself once, guarded by `VITADECK_PINNED_NODE`, so the whole tier silently runs on Node 24 after one stderr line.
`smoke` is not in the `case`, so it never re-execs; it runs Node inside Docker.

groups.title: Install and build JS before tsc
groups.why: `tsc` reads the SDK `dist` and the `.vitadeck/` font types that only `vitadeck build` writes, so a fresh tree failed with `"mono"` errors [retro item 4](source:s1).
groups.summary: `run_fast` and `run_host` call `install_js`, and `run_fast` runs `pnpm --dir js build` before the typecheck.
lookFor: Perf: `fast` now costs about 6 s more for the JS build; a no-op `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` takes 36 ms.
Subtle: `--frozen-lockfile` makes `fast` fail when `package.json` changed without a lockfile update, where it used to pass.

groups.title: docker compose, not docker-compose
groups.why: `docker-compose` is not installed on this Mac while `docker compose` is [retro item 4](source:s1).
groups.summary: The `vitadeck-build` skill and `AGENTS.md` switch every `docker-compose run` to `docker compose run`, and `run_vita` drops its fallback.

commits.subject: fix(scripts): agent-check runs on the pinned Node and builds JS before tsc
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A fresh worktree started on the shell's default Node 22 and without the SDK dist or the examples' generated
.vitadeck font types, so the fast tier failed with '"mono"' type errors. agent-check now reruns itself on the
.nvmrc Node through fnm, installs, and builds JS before typechecking. pnpm install fails on an old Node
instead of succeeding. The docs called docker-compose, which is not installed; use docker compose.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
